tasks.title: Retain file observation for digest and parsing
tasks.goal: Use one safely held source observation for every returned byte and identity.
steps: Retain root/parent/file capabilities and read through the existing safe seam.
Compute raw digest and parsing input from the same buffer or retained stream.
Define pre/post stability witnesses and honest unavailable handling without weakening single-link ownership.
positive_cases: Stable regular file yields exact bytes and matching digest.
negative_cases: Links, reparse points, hardlinks or concurrent replacement cannot silently receive stable success.

tasks.title: Prove membership against trusted captured source
tasks.goal: Separate local record agreement from independent source proof.
steps: Build a bounded immutable index from a capture verified against its trusted hash recipe.
Check document membership independently of mutable slot-record hashes.
Return observed, record-consistent or source-proven strength; strict missing-capture requests refuse offline.
positive_cases: Verified captured member reaches source-proven; development source remains observed.
negative_cases: Coordinated record/payload tampering and an unrecorded document cannot become source-proven.

tasks.title: Bind builtin converter and overlay provenance
tasks.goal: Prove transformed returned bytes using existing pure conversion.
steps: Run only pure builtin conversion over verified capture bytes in memory.
Bind descriptor, converter recipe, authorized overlay and source-output map.
Compare materialized output before assigning derivation-proven; expose carriers reusable by later M-10.
positive_cases: Declared Vibe XML has a named converter and exact output proof.
negative_cases: Converter/overlay/output drift refuses; native conversion never runs implicitly.
